ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation mapping across 98% of both lobes; localized high-contrast white geometric clusters (barnacle colonies) are mapped to the distal tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped median notch with a wide aperture and a pixel-depth ratio of approximately 1:15 relative to horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, stochastic serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; characterized by numerous sharp pixel-level peaks and jagged V-shaped valleys, particularly dense on the inner right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the outer-lateral margins leading to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular white pixel clusters localized on the trailing and leading edges of both distal tips; distinct circular ring-shaped marks (potential parasitic attachment sites) visible on the mid-to-lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks detected; one horizontal mark on the mid-left lobe and multiple short, multidirectional marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe immediately lateral to the median notch, distinct from the standard serration pattern.
